claim_scope: p50/mean/p95/p99 40.31%-53.85% lower, both directions, clean drifts

protocol.processes: one fresh process per A/B/B/A leg; samples within each leg run in-process
protocol.acceptance: a statistic is accepted only when candidate elapsed time is lower in both paired directions and control/candidate same-implementation drift stays within that statistic's threshold
protocol.percentiles: p50 = statistics.median; p95/p99 = nearest-rank (tools/perf_compare.py method); drift = (second_leg - first_leg) / first_leg

binaries.note: control is the banked 0215 binary; candidate adds the 0216 discard-but-validate text extraction in litchi-odt

provenance.source_state: HEAD 9b717bb08 plus uncommitted changes 0192-0196, 0198-0202, 0204, 0206, 0207, 0209-0212, and 0215 (both binaries); the candidate additionally carries the 0216 discard-but-validate text extraction in litchi-odt

timing_scope: source-backed owner and four output slots prepared outside timer; four public full-text projections inside timer; semantic, archive, media, source-range, freshness, and zero-post-preparation-read gates outside timer
verification: harness-embedded corpus hash identical across legs; in-harness semantic/read-evidence gates passed on every leg (a failed gate aborts the leg with a non-zero exit)
